info.title: RKD Interior Production API
info.description: Tenant-scoped API boundary for the vertical MVP. The server builds CommandEnvelopeV1 and never accepts direct database or executor writes from clients. M5 local account pilot authenticates using a server-side session cookie; OIDC/serviceToken are reference contracts, not implemented runtime providers. All project routes including downloads require current project authorization in account mode. Legacy command execution is closed in launched local/account modes.
